cases.review: The unversioned shareablecodesystem canonical has different installed definitions. R4 core 4.0.1 has no scs-1 constraint; CRMI 2.0.0 ships version 4.0.2 with that constraint. HAPI reports scs-1 while Records accepts the resource. This supports a canonical-selection hypothesis; align and record the selected definition before attributing an engine defect. No disagreement is removed from the counts.

cases.review: HAPI explicitly applies IHE.MHD.UniqueIdIdentifier|4.2.3 and requires Identifier.use. The example belongs to IHE MHD 4.2.2, whose corresponding definition allows use to be absent (min=0); 4.2.3 changes min to 1. The diagnostic also includes offline MIME-system inference. A controlled comparison must align the datatype profile version before assigning a missing-cardinality defect. Counts remain unchanged.
